text:
[Council File 15-0989-S75]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
AD HOC COMMITTEE ON THE 2028 OLYMPIC AND PARALYMPIC GAMES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a request that the LA28 establish a guaranteed, measurable, City of Los Angeles-specific procurement spending commitment, distinct from the LA28’s existing five-county “local” business definition, with a target of the LA28’s addressable procurement commensurate with the City’s role as Games Host.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Harris-Dawson - Rodriguez, Soto-Martinez):
1. DIRECT the Bureau of Contract Administration (BCA), Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), the City Administrative Officer (CAO), and the Mayor's Office, in coordination with the Council President's Office, to formally request that LA28 establish a guaranteed, measurable, City of Los Angeles-specific procurement spending commitment, distinct from LA28's existing five-county “local” business definition, with a target of LA28's addressable procurement commensurate with the city’s role as Games Host.
2. DIRECT the BCA, CLA and CAO to report back to Council within 15 days on the status of procurement negotiations with LA28, including any City-specific spending commitments obtained, mechanisms proposed for tracking and enforcing such commitments, and opportunities for the City to increase local business readiness and participation, including in historically under-invested communities.
3. REQUEST the LA28 to provide the City with a written response regarding its position on a City of Los Angeles-specific procurement minimum, including any proposed governance, tracking, or coordination structure to monitor progress toward local procurement goals.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
